description: At the Seoul AI Safety Summit (co-hosted by the UK, May 21-22, 2024), 16 leading AI developers signed the Seoul Frontier AI Safety Commitments, pledging to publish detailed safety frameworks by the next summit. The frameworks were released ahead of and around the Paris AI Action Summit (Feb 10-11, 2025).
